Author: namibj
Content:
> Yes I have, but they seem to have too much friction for precision applications or induce play if they are manufactured with a loose fit.
This one in particular regarding these makes me wonder if the DIY porous graphite block spherical air bearings AppliedScience demonstrated a few years back would scale/be approriate, as AFAIK those can be set up to have no stiction and the air in the gap acts first order as a pretty linear spring which would imply decently behaved kinematic modeling and should at least for sufficiently limited-required-stiffness applications provide acceptable "lack of wiggle/play".....
